phase: Phase 3: A green gate independent of active-track Red
summary: Phase 3 Green passes the requested UX/API contract audit. The new `npm run test:shipped` script is the deterministic shipped-surface green gate, fully independent of the active track's four S1 intentional-Red files and of `npm run parity`. lib/green-gate.mjs#partitionTests is exact-name matching (Set.has) over four candidate path forms — bare English words like 'red' or 'skip' are not filters — and produces byte-identical results across repeated calls. scripts/test-shipped.mjs reads `tests/.track-red-files.txt` correctly (comment lines, blank lines, and whitespace all filtered) and emits the explicit partition listing `[shipped] running N: ...; [track-red] excluded M: ...; [unclassified] U: ...`. Against the live repo, partitionTests returns exactly 5 shipped (core, green-gate, model-resolution, parity, setup), 4 trackRed (agents-snapshot, grammar, manifest, preflight), and 0 unclassified. `node scripts/test-shipped.mjs` exits 0 with all 37 shipped assertions passing; `npm test` exits 1 with exactly 4 failures (the documented S1 intentional-Red files). package.json was modified by an additive single-line change that introduces `test:shipped` while leaving the existing `test`, `check`, `parity`, `configure`, and `migrate-auth` scripts untouched. Phase 1 (parity 11/11) and Phase 2 (model-resolution 9/9, core 5/5) show no regression. The Node v22.22.3 recursive-test compatibility adapter in lib/green-gate.mjs is a narrowly scoped, opt-in shim that only fires when a child `node --test` is invoked with exactly two argv entries (a single test file); the production gate passes 5 files so this adapter does not fire on the production invocation path.

nonblocking_findings.description: lib/green-gate.mjs contains a `NODE_TEST_CONTEXT === 'child-v8'` shim that adds `--experimental-test-isolation=none` to child `node --test` invocations when args.length === 2 (single-file recursive probe). The production `scripts/test-shipped.mjs` invokes `node --test` with the shipped partition (5 files; args.length === 6), so the adapter does not fire on the production path. This matches phase-3-green.json NF-1 (review should confirm the adapter is narrowly scoped); confirmed — adapter is gated on the test runner's child-v8 environment and only re-injects a flag for single-file child invocations.

tests/.track-red-files.txt is the single source of truth for which files are excluded from `npm run test:shipped`. If a future phase adds a fifth intentional-Red file, the list must be updated in the same PR or the green gate will report it as an unclassified_test_file (hard failure). This is the documented contract (test-strategy §1, plan Task 3.3); no defect, but a maintenance surface future contributors must own.

Pre-existing dirty edits to agents/*.md (16 files), config/model-map.json, and measure/tracks.md are NOT included in the Phase 3 Green commit per the task's absolute constraint to not commit unrelated dirty files. The green gate's `node --test` invocation exits 0 against the dirty tree because none of these dirty edits affect tests/ or scripts/. The `npm run parity` exit 1 reflects Phase 2's fail-closed unmapped-model behavior, not a Phase 3 regression.
